meta.title: momo-keikaku
meta.description: Plan, work done and the numbers, in agreement.

baselines.a_baseline_is_never_edited_every_version: A Baseline is never edited. Every version is kept with its author, time and reason.
baselines.whether_an_hour_counts_as_baselined_is_j: Whether an hour counts as baselined is judged against the Baseline version active when its ledger entry was recorded, so a Re-baseline never erases Unplanned history. The active Baseline is selected by sequence, never by comparing timestamps.
baselines.none_recorded: No Baseline has been recorded yet.
baselines.demo_not_wired: Not in this demo: Set Baseline / Re-baseline actions and version comparison (FR-16). BAC today is {bac}h.
baselines.set_disabled_title: Set Baseline is unavailable until every leaf is schedulable and the latest schedule run succeeded.
baselines.set_blocked: Fix Project start or incomplete leaf durations before setting a Baseline.
baselines.not_schedulable_link: {count} not schedulable yet — open exceptions rail
baselines.bac_with_active: Active Baseline BAC is {bac}h. Re-baseline and version comparison land in later stories.

connectors.connectors_are_read_only_the_offshore_te: Connectors are read-only. The offshore team keeps working in Backlog; nothing is asked of them and nothing is ever written back.
connectors.detected_from_the_data_never_from_the_pl: Detected from the data, never from the plan name: measurement basis
connectors.not_in_this_demo_credential_entry_and_ro: Not in this demo: credential entry and rotation, the scheduled snapshot job (pg-boss), on-demand refresh, and Tracker Account → Resource linking as a UI. The seed replays all six snapshots in one pass.
connectors.opening_balance_row: {hours}h — hours the Tickets already carried before momo-keikaku could observe them

mapping.rules_are_live_on_every_tracker_snapshot: Rules are live: on every Tracker Snapshot each Ticket without a manual Mapping is re-evaluated in priority order. A manual Mapping always wins.
mapping.the_60_tickets_carrying_the_most_hours_m: The 60 Tickets carrying the most hours. Map, remap or unmap; the Review updates in place.
mapping.mappings_persist_across_tracker_snapshot: Mappings persist across Tracker Snapshots and Plan edits. Attribution follows the current Mapping, so a remap moves the hours immediately and the ledger itself is never rewritten.
mapping.a_rule_showing_0_tickets_is_not_broken_t: A rule showing 0 Tickets is not broken: those Tickets already carry a manual Mapping, which a rule never overrides.
mapping.title: Title
mapping.money_is_never_shown_on_client_surfaces_: Money is never shown on client surfaces. Every Mapping change is recorded with its author and time in the audit log.

ledger.scope_ledger_every_hour_in_the_connector: Scope ledger — every hour in the Connector's scope, in one of four buckets
ledger.buckets_footnote: The four buckets are mutually exclusive and sum to {totalHours}h — nothing in scope is silently excluded. Opening Balances ({openingHours}h) sit outside the bar and are reported separately.

mapping.coverage_summary: {hourShare} of hours mapped · {ticketShare} of Tickets mapped · {unmappedTickets} Unmapped Tickets. The share of Tickets and the share of hours are reported separately on purpose.

plan.the_baseline_is_never_edited: The Baseline is never edited: plan changes go to the Current Plan, and the Baseline moves only through an explicit, reasoned Re-baseline.
plan.summary_rows_roll_up_effort: Summary rows roll up effort from their children. Actual dates are a leaf Work Package's own, from its latest status event.
plan.baseline_recorded: recorded {date} — "{reason}" · BAC {bac}h over {leafCount} baselined leaf Work Packages.

review.the_overall_status_is_the_worst_of_the_t: The overall status is the worst of the three indicators. Each shows the rule behind its colour.
review.hours_spent_outside_the_baselined_plan_t: Hours spent outside the baselined plan. They carry actual effort and no earned value — this is information about how accurate the plan is, not a judgement of people.
review.measured_in_effort_hours_the_money_colum: Measured in effort hours (工数). The money column is derived (hours × Rate) and is internal only.
review.the_three_components_of_unplanned_work_c: The three components of Unplanned Work (cumulative)
review.unmapped_work_by_tracker_attribute_expan: Unmapped Work by Tracker attribute — expand to Tickets

componentSource.unmapped: Tickets in the Connector's scope with no Mapping to a Work Package.
componentSource.non_baselined: Work Packages that exist in the Current Plan but carry no Baseline hours — for example WPs created by the Plan disposition. Their hours stay Unplanned until a Re-baseline.
componentSource.catch_all_overflow: A Catch-all Work Package is measured as Level of Effort. Hours beyond its Baseline hours are Unplanned Work, and appear only here, so they are never counted twice.

disposition.attribution_follows_the_current_mapping_: Attribution follows the current Mapping, so these hours leave Unplanned Work immediately.
disposition.counts_as_unplanned_work_until_the_next_: Counts as Unplanned Work until the next Re-baseline includes the new WP.
disposition.clients_see_this_note_only_if_you_publis: Clients see this note only if you publish it.
disposition.all_dispositioned: All Unmapped Work has a Disposition.
disposition.queue_waiting: {count, plural, one {# group waiting} other {# groups waiting}}. Unplanned Work is {hours}h.
disposition.unmapped_tickets: {count, plural, one {# Unmapped Ticket} other {# Unmapped Tickets}}
disposition.map_tickets_submit: Map {count, plural, one {# Ticket} other {# Tickets}}

review.divergence_by_work_package_baseline_vs_c: Divergence by Work Package — Baseline vs Current Plan vs actual
review.no_baseline_yet: No Baseline yet. EVM starts once you set one.
review.no_baseline_yet_detail: Coverage and actual hours do not need a Baseline. The Unplanned Work split is shown for information and is not judged until a Baseline is recorded, because until then every mapped hour counts as non-baselined.
review.the_effort_forecast_is_the_eac_from_the_: The effort forecast is the EAC from the Project's EAC Method, so it includes Unplanned Work.
review.approximate_hours_are_derived_from_the_d: Approximate — hours are derived from the difference between Tracker Snapshots, not from worklogs. Any breakdown by person or by day is approximate for that reason, and no view ranks or scores people by Unplanned Work.
review.title: Title

metrics.formula_cpi_planned: CPI = EV ÷ AC of baselined WPs only
metrics.note_spi: {ev}h ÷ {pv}h — {behind, select, true {behind plan} other {on or ahead of plan}}
metrics.note_cpi_gap: The gap between the two CPIs is the Unplanned Work.
metrics.note_sv: {behind, select, true {Behind plan} other {Ahead of plan}}
metrics.note_eac: EAC Method: Typical — the only method in R0
metrics.note_vac: Negative means the forecast overruns the budget
metrics.formula_forecast_trend: Trend heuristic, not a PMI formula

unplanned.total_row_rates: {amount} at the Rates in effect when each hour was recorded
unplanned.opening_balance_footnote: Opening Balance {hours}h — hours the Tickets already carried before momo-keikaku could observe them. Counted in cumulative AC, excluded from period metrics, so a Project connected mid-flight shows no false spike.
unplanned.mapping_coverage: Mapping coverage: {hourShare} of hours and {ticketShare} of Tickets are mapped (FR-23 reports the two separately).

divergence.footnote: {leafCount} leaf Work Packages in the Current Plan; {baselineCount} carry Baseline hours or are Milestones. Percent Complete is never derived from burned effort.

evm.cpi_money_footnote: CPI in money can differ from CPI in hours, because the people planned and the people who did the work can have different Rates. Money above uses the Project default Rate of {defaultRate}/h for PV and EV, and the per-Resource Rate in effect for AC.

pv.name: PV — Planned Value
pv.formula: Baseline hours spread over baseline working days, to the as-of date
pv.reading: What the Baseline said would be earned by now

ac.name: AC — Actual Cost (all-in)
ac.formula: Actuals Ledger, attributed by the current Mapping

planned_scope.name: — of which planned scope
planned_scope.formula: AC of baselined WPs (incl. Catch-all within its Baseline)

unplanned_line.name: — of which Unplanned (PV = EV = 0)
unplanned_line.reading: Actual effort with no earned value

cpi_all_in.name: CPI (all-in)
cpi_all_in.reading: < 1 means over budget. This is the headline figure and the one every EAC uses.

cpi_planned.name: CPI (planned scope)
cpi_planned.formula: CPI = EV ÷ AC of baselined WPs
cpi_planned.reading: Higher than all-in CPI: the planned work is close to plan; the overrun is Unplanned Work.

tcpi.name: TCPI
tcpi.reading: > 1.1 means the remaining work must beat the planned efficiency — a red flag.

bac.name: BAC — Budget at Completion
bac.formula: Σ Baseline hours over baselined leaf WPs
